act.long_title: An Act to consolidate and amend the law relating to Criminal Procedure.

section.heading: Search for persons wrongfully confined
section.html:
If any District Magistrate, Sub-divisional Magistrate or Magistrate of the first class has reason to believe that any person is confined under such circumstances that the confinement amounts to an offence, he

may issue a search-warrant, and the person to whom such warrant is

directed may search for the person so confined; and such search shall be made in accordance therewith, and the person, if found, shall be immediately taken before a Magistrate, who shall make such order as in the circumstances of the case seems proper.
